title: A CRIER GOES BACK ON PATROL
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. A Crier that heard a noise, was called by a machine that spotted you, or was caught in a blast wandered at random for the rest of the raid wearing a question mark or a red mark, the same red mark as a Crier raising the alarm, though it was raising nothing. It was counted among the machines coming for the ring, could drive the heartbeat, and if it wandered indoors it never left, because the rule that walks a Crier out of a house only works on patrol. It now walks to the noise, and once it gets there or its timer runs out it goes back on patrol.
now: A Crier that heard something goes back on patrol once it has looked, and walks out of houses again.
